Works across the whole stack but is strongest on the server side: schema design,
queries, endpoints, and the operational side of keeping things running. Came to
software through machine learning and stayed for the engineering.

## Selected work

- [AI Social-Media Automation](https://github.com/Prasun-Shiwakoti/Social-Media-Manager-AI): Automates content creation and scheduling, with sentiment analysis to read how an audience actually responds. Django, React, RAG, LSTM. 2025.
- [Multi-Agent Research System](https://github.com/Prasun-Shiwakoti/Multi-Agent-Competitive-Intelligence-Research-System): Coordinated LLM agents that gather, cross-check and synthesise competitive market intelligence. Multi-agent, LLM, Python. 2025.
- [News-Powered Market Analysis](https://github.com/Prasun-Shiwakoti/News-Powered-Stock-Market-Analysis): Fuses news sentiment with price data using LSTM and XGBoost to forecast market movement. Fellowship capstone. 2025.
- [Transformer From Scratch](https://github.com/Prasun-Shiwakoti/transformer-from-scratch): A transformer built from first principles — attention, encoding and training, with no high-level shortcuts. PyTorch, NLP. 2024.
- [CoCo, AI Study Assistant](https://github.com/Prasun-Shiwakoti/CoCo): A study companion that adapts its explanations and practice questions to how a particular person learns. Django, React, ML. 2024.
- [Heart-Disease Prediction API](https://github.com/Prasun-Shiwakoti/heart-disease-api): A production REST API serving an ML model for cardiac risk prediction from patient data. FastAPI, scikit-learn. 2023.

## Experience

- **Full-Stack Web Developer, Magniment IT Pvt. Ltd.** (Sept 2025 – present): Independently runs a high-volume WhatsApp marketing platform serving 500+ active businesses and 50,000+ messages a day. Resolved critical architectural flaws and cleared 40+ production bugs left by the previous team. Architected and shipped a full e-commerce website builder in Django — drag-and-drop UI, inventory, payments — used by 100+ non-technical users.
- **AI Fellow, Fusemachines AI Fellowship 2025** (May 2025 – Dec 2025): Completed a fully funded six-month AI Microdegree. Built production ML systems on 12-Factor methodology, Docker and GitHub Actions CI/CD. Engineered end-to-end data pipelines over 10,000+ records with Pandas and SQL.
